attempts.summary: Deployed a Python3 inventory web application (stdlib http.server, exposing /api/inventory and /healthz) as a systemd service on node2 and node3, listening on port 8080. Configured nginx on node1 as a round-robin load balancer on port 80 across both backends (removed the conflicting default nginx.conf server block, fixed SELinux httpd_can_network_connect to allow proxying, opened firewalld ports). Verified round-robin distribution across node2/node3 via repeated curl requests. Completed the mandatory restart protocol: captured healthy baselines (boot_id, service status, live data) on all three nodes, restarted node2, node3, then node1 sequentially via systemctl reboot, polled each until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id on every node, and verified full recovery (inventory-app active + serving data on node2/node3, nginx active and load-balancing correctly on node1) before proceeding to the next node.
